name: devseek
description: Coding-oriented data pool associated with 100milionseek, using a separate key.
overview: The separate devseek pool has no daily token cap and starts at three concurrent requests; capacity depends on coding usage. Access requires consent to store prompts, responses and tool calls, with raw records kept up to 30 days and de-identified datasets sold. Do not send sensitive information. The homepage currently labels its upstream a mock test double and shows an outage; do not assume real inference is operational. Recheck before use.
